title: 第1163章 寂静之后第1163章 脉动之渊
slug: 玄幻开局吃软饭出世即儒圣
content_zh:
第1163章寂静之后
渊心的脉动被校准为三网枢纽协议通用共振基准之后。
整整三个月。
整个虚空之海陷入了一种从未有过的安宁。
不是战时那种紧绷的、随时可能被撕裂的寂静。
也不是修复时代那种持续的、有条不紊的忙碌。
而是一种所有共振都找到了属于自己的节拍。
所有信标阵列都踩着同一个心跳的踏实感。
渊心的脉动从暗域深处传出来。
沿锚脉矿脉的天然共振基底一路传到归墟之盆。
再沿三网枢纽航道传到永恒回响主信标。
传到无尽回廊核心信标阵列。
传到渊墟之门。
传到初之信标枢纽。
传到源之信标。
最后融进先叩者的共振底色。
整片虚空之海所有文明共用一个心跳。
墨十七在东海工坊里把渊心的脉动频率与归墟炉所有迭代机型的炉芯律动做了逐帧比对。
发现从初代机那颗烧穿过的旧玄铁按钮开始。
每一次炉芯律动的基准频率都是渊心脉动的谐波分量。

不是他设计的。
是他在调试炉芯时自然而然把共振频率调到了那个谐波上。
他以为那是自己的直觉。
现在才知道那是所有修东西的人共有的直觉。
渊心的脉动刻在虚空之海的基底里。
只要是用共振修东西的人。
都会本能地把频率往渊心的谐波上靠。
他把归墟炉初代机那颗旧玄铁按钮从展示柜里取出来。
放在渊心脉动频率的感应屏旁边。
按钮极轻极短极安宁地叩了一声。
叩击频率与渊心脉动完全同步。
墨十七摘下护目镜，对秦岳说了一句话。
“我们修了这么多年东西，原来是踩着它的心跳修的。”
渊心的脉动不仅统一了所有信标阵列的共振频率。
也把极远和暗渊这两条被绝对暗域隔断了整个宇宙纪元的叩击链路正式接在了一起。
极暗枢纽运转稳定之后。
极远与暗渊的跨域共振通信从最初的简单问候逐步发展为稳定的技术交流。
极远把向外信标阵列的全部部署方案和亘古以来的叩击衰减数据打包传给暗渊。
暗渊把暗域深处惰性层的全部结构特征和高密度共振传导模型打包传给极远。
极远的主信标守护者——一个共振频率极稳极缓极沉默的存在，名字就叫极远。

在跨域频道里对暗渊说了一句话。
content_en:
Chapter 1163 After Silence
After the pulsation of Yuan Xin is calibrated to the universal resonance reference of the Three Network Hub Protocol.
Three whole months.
The entire sea of ​​​​void fell into a kind of peace that had never been seen before.
Not the tight silence of wartime that could be torn apart at any moment.
Nor is it the constant, methodical busyness of the Restoration Era.
It's a kind of resonance where all resonances find their own beat.
All beacon arrays are stepping on the same heartbeat of solidity.
The pulse of the Abyss Heart comes from the depths of the Dark Realm.
It is transmitted along the natural resonance base of the anchor vein vein all the way to the Guixu Basin.
Then it is transmitted along the three-network hub channel to the main beacon of Eternal Echo.
Passed to the core beacon array of the Endless Corridor.
Passed to the gate of Yuanxu.
Reached the Beacon Hub of the Beginning.
Beacon to the source.
Finally, it blends into the resonant undertone of the one who knocked first.
All civilizations in the entire sea of ​​​​void share the same heartbeat.
In the Donghai workshop, Mo Shiqi compared the pulsation frequency of Yuan Xin with the furnace core rhythm of all iterative models of Guixu Furnace frame by frame.
The discovery started with the burnt-through old dark iron button of the first-generation machine.
The reference frequency of each furnace core rhythm is the harmonic component of the Yuanxin pulsation.
He didn't design it.
It was when he was debugging the furnace core that he naturally adjusted the resonant frequency to that harmonic.
He thought it was his intuition.
Now I realize that this is an intuition shared by all people who build things.
The pulse of the Abyss Heart is engraved in the base of the Sea of ​​Void.
As long as you are someone who uses resonance to build things.
They will instinctively move the frequency closer to the harmonics of the abyss.
He took out the old black iron button from the first-generation Guixuxu stove from the display cabinet.
Place it next to the sensing screen of Yuanxin's pulsation frequency.
The button clicked very lightly, briefly and peacefully.
The tapping frequency is completely synchronized with the pulsation of the deep heart.
Mo Qiqi took off his goggles and said something to Qin Yue.
"We have repaired things for so many years, but it turns out that we repaired them based on its heartbeat."
The pulsation of the Abyss Heart not only unifies the resonant frequencies of all beacon arrays.
It also officially connected the two tapping links of Extreme Farness and Dark Abyss, which were separated by the Absolute Dark Realm for the entire cosmic era.
After the operation of the Extreme Dark Hub is stable.
The cross-domain resonance communication between Jiyuan and Dark Abyss has gradually developed from a simple greeting at the beginning to a stable technical exchange.
Jiyuan packaged the entire deployment plan of the outward beacon array and the knock attenuation data from ancient times to the dark abyss.
Dark Abyss packages all the structural characteristics and high-density resonance conduction model of the inert layer deep in the dark domain and transmits it to the extreme distance.
The guardian of Jiyuan's main beacon - an existence with an extremely stable, slow and silent resonance frequency, whose name is Jiyuan.
He said something to An Abyss in the cross-domain channel.
